text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega is both a rival of her 
generation and someone Narita Top Road has 
always admired and strived to catch up to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their long-awaited debut together. Narita 
Top Road was hungry for victory, but the 
Yayoi Sho was merely a prelude to the 
Satsuki Sho—the first jewel of the Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, assess the opponent's true 
strength. Just how far away is the distant 
star that is her idol, Admire Vega—?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To throw everything she had built up into 
the fray, Narita Top Road runs the Yayoi 
Sho!
